title: Two Books, One Topic
description: Compare two short informational texts about apples, identify shared and new facts, find authors' reasons, and explain what was learned.
learningFocus: Identify similarities and differences between two texts on the same topic (RI.1.9).
Identify reasons an author gives to support points in a text (RI.1.8).
Use words and pictures to clarify the meaning of unfamiliar words and phrases (RI.1.4), while reading grade-appropriate informational texts with support (RI.1.10).
adultGuidance: Two books can tell about one topic. Help your child read both books about apples. Ask what is the same in both books, and what is new in each one. Point to the reason the author gives. Help your child work out a hard word from the words and picture near it. Then let your child tell what they learned.
